content.text: {"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot \"accessory\" is for an item no other slot fits.", "\"is_outfit\" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following \"answer_schema\", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": ["\"description\" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "A refined black silk blouse with a subtle sheen, tailored in a classic slightly boxy cut to the shoulder line and falling to the hip, paired with high-waisted straight-leg dark denim trousers that taper just above the ankle. A structured charcoal wool blazer, cut with clean lines and minimal hardware, worn as an outer layer to provide warmth against the autumn chill while maintaining a professional silhouette. Chunky black leather loafers with a low heel, designed for stability while standing in a crowd, finished with a simple round toe and no excessive detailing. Small silver geometric stud earrings and a slim black leather clutch with magnetic closure complete the look without distracting from the classic aesthetic. This outfit works because it balances the raw energy of a rock concert with her desire for a restrained and classic appearance by using timeless tailoring and dark, neutral tones. The structured blazer adds a layer of sophistication appropriate for an evening out, while the sturdy loafers ensure she remains comfortable and grounded while standing in the crowd."}
